messages:
maya: Heads-up: onboarding lotus-14b (community 14B) — quantized q4_0 shows positional drift in long contexts; KV cache looks like it's shifting by one chunk after ~1024 tokens. Repro + logs below, need prioritization for runtime bring-up and possible fallback policy.

samir: Can you paste a minimal repro and logs?

maya: Sure — minimal repro (local):
```bash
# run with our rift runtime and KV logging
python tools/run_infer.py --model ./models/lotus-14b --quant q4_0 --seq_len 2048 --prompt_file tests/long_context.txt --engine rift --log-kv > lotus_q4_repro.log
```
And snippet from lotus_q4_repro.log:
```
[INFO] kcache: insert idx=1023 -> stored_pos=0 (wrap)
[DEBUG] attention.rotary: phase_delta prev=0.002312 curr=-0.002198
[WARN] kv_lookup: returned token 1024 for query pos=1023
[ERROR] decode: token shift detected: expected pos=1536 got 1535
```
These only appear on q4_0/q5_k quant variants; q8_0 and fp16 runs are fine.

samir: Hmm, looks like a RoPE/phase sign flip at wrap. Which tokenizer and seqlen config were used?

maya: Default bpe tokenization from base infra (same as other onboarded models). seqlen=2048, chunk size=1024 (our continuous-batching path splits into 1024 windows).

elaine: Assigning eng-runtime to triage. @prashant can you pick this up?

prashant: I'll take it. Quick q: any recent kernel or packing changes that could touch reorder/stride?

maya: We merged the flash-attn kernel patch + weight weight-packing reorder last week (PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/4021). Suspect index calc in continuous-batch path interacting with quant packing.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: nightly build #2185 for eng-runtime finished — all unit tests green.

samir: If only quant variants show the issue, dequant/reorder code is suspect — maybe leading-dim layout differs (NCHW vs NHWC style) so position offsets get mixed. Also check pack_weights for stride changes.

maya: Running a raw float weight-dump diff now between q8_0 and q4_0 pack outputs; will attach results. Preliminary look: q4_0 pack changes a transpose in the head dims before storing, might explain phase permute.

elaine: For prioritization: impact = medium (affects ~1% of hosted traffic currently for lotus canaries), severity = correctness (generation drift). I propose priority P1 to avoid customer regressions. Agree?

prashant: Agree P1. Plan: add failing unit test that simulates index-wrap at chunk boundary (1023->0), reproduce KV lookup off-by-one, then attempt fix in continuous-batching index calc and weight unpack path. Also add automatic fallback: if token overlap metric drops >5% in canary, fallback to q8_0 for that route. I'll draft the fallback policy.

maya: For evals: we should add a long-context benchmark (2k-8k) with deterministic prompts that stress position wrap. Metrics: perplexity drift, token overlap ratio, exact-match subsequences, and generation alignment score. I'll add prompt set to evaluations repo under evals/lotus/long-wrap.

samir: Also add a unit that mimics RoPE phase continuity: feed sequential inputs that cross chunk boundary and assert phase delta continuity (abs(delta) < 1e-3).

maya: :thumbsup: I'll update the onboarding intake doc with repro command, logs and eval links. tagging #eng-ml and #eng-runtime.

prashant: Opening a runtime PR with failing test + proposed index fix. Will ping once CI hits the failing case.

maya: Closing the loop here — assigning to prashant, flagged as P1. I'll run the weight-dump diffs and add them to the ticket. Thanks all.
